summary: Your seat or the bigger race: The deadline to file for your own seat comes before you know whether you will be on {the bigger ticket}.
realLife: One life: In July 2016, the day Trump announced him as his running mate, he filed to end his own race for re-election as Indiana governor; his lieutenant governor took his place and won. Another: In 2000 he ran for re-election to the Senate while he was the Democrats' vice-presidential nominee, and kept his seat. Another: He did not run for a second Senate term in 2004 and backed Erskine Bowles, who lost the seat to a Republican.
